summary: A huge indoor automotive showcase at IMPACT Challenger Halls 1–3, Muang Thong Thani, with cars, motorcycles, mobility technology and accessories. Best shortlisted by vehicle enthusiasts who enjoy comparing displays and photographing new models; budget half a day including travel from central Bangkok. The official 2026 event is confirmed for 2–13 December.
whyGo: See many vehicle brands and designs together in one large exhibition.
An inexpensive, mostly indoor option for anyone curious about Thailand’s car and motorcycle market.
bestFor: Travellers comfortable with busy trade-show environments
skipIf: Cars have little appeal: this is primarily a commercial vehicle exhibition.
You want a compact central-Bangkok stop or dislike crowds and long walks.
duration: Planning estimate: 2–4 hours inside, plus travel; enthusiasts may spend most of a day.
cost: 100 THB per person per day; online three-day pass 240 THB. Children no taller than 120 cm enter free. Official FAQ says visitors over 60 and disabled visitors can exchange for admission at Challenger 1–3 ticket counters. Transport and food extra.
hours: 2 December 2026 charity day: 12:00–22:00. Public days 3–13 December: weekdays 12:00–22:00, weekends and public holidays 11:00–22:00. 1 December is press/VIP preview, not ordinary public admission.
bestTime: A weekday shortly after opening is a sensible crowd-avoidance choice; this is planning advice, not an attendance guarantee.
gettingThere: Venue is in Muang Thong Thani, Nonthaburi, outside central Bangkok. Taxi/ride-hailing is straightforward in principle but allow substantial traffic time. Official FAQ lists a free Mo Chit–IMPACT shuttle; check the event shuttle page for boarding points and operating timetable before travelling.
booking: Buy at Challenger Halls 1–3 counters or through the official online-ticket link/app. Online tickets provide a QR code. Get an exit stamp if you intend to re-enter the same day.
accessibility: Large halls involve considerable walking. Disabled visitors qualify for ticket-counter admission exchange according to the FAQ; specific wheelchair routes, assistance, accessible transport and sensory provisions were not verified.
practicalTips: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a light layer for indoor air-conditioning.
Check the final exhibitor and activity lists before making a special trip for a particular brand.
Do not assume test drives or vehicle access are included; exhibitor conditions may apply.
The linked photo shows the actual 2023 expo, illustrating scale and crowding rather than the 2026 lineup.
decemberNotes: Fixed-date option: 2–13 December 2026 only. Charity-day admission on 2 December costs 100 THB; complimentary tickets generally start 3 December. Prefer the organiser’s noon opening time on 2 December over conflicting third-party listings.
uncertainties: Final 2026 vehicle lineup, demonstrations and test-drive eligibility were not checked.
Free-shuttle precise schedule, journey duration and accessible arrangements need reconfirmation.
